description: Create a new formula field — shorthand for `create_field` with type "formula". Use `create_field` for all other field types (singleSelect, rollup, number, etc.). Returns { columnId }.

debug.description: When true, include raw Airtable response in output for diagnostics

formulaFilePath.description: Path to a local .formula or .fx file. When provided, reads formula from file instead of formulaText (unblocks large formulas that exceed LLM output limits). The # AT: metadata header is stripped automatically.

name.description: Name for the new formula field

name: create_formula_field
